newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani Central Depository Co to start in May.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani Central Depository Co to start in May.

text.p: The Central Depository Co of Pakistan Ltd (CDC), which will computerise share deals, will start work in May, CDC chairman Arif Habib said on Saturday.
The CDC project, estimated to cost 180 million rupees, will be functional by May and it will facilitate scrip handling, he told a seminar on the working of the central depository system.
"Our mandate is to provide a transparent and efficient market place," said Habib, who is also the president of Pakistan's main Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE).
A member of a brokerage house said the CDC was expected to boost trading and investment in stocks by overseas investors because of the system's reliability, integrity and confidentiality.
The benefits of the CDC are efficient delivery, settlement, transfer of securities and transactions through the computerised book entry system, the member said.
